name: xiangqi-firebase
description: Cờ tướng web: AI 6 mức, online 1vs1 (Firebase RTDB + Cloud Functions), xếp hạng, phòng bạn bè, người xem.

scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm --prefix functions run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/engine && npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm --prefix functions run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run test:engine && vitest run --config tests/vitest.config.mts tests/unit
scripts.test:rules: node scripts/with-java.mjs firebase emulators:exec --project demo-xiangqi --only database,firestore,auth "vitest run --config tests/vitest.config.mts tests/rules"
scripts.test:integration: npm --prefix functions run build && node scripts/with-java.mjs firebase emulators:exec --project demo-xiangqi --only database,firestore,auth,functions,tasks "vitest run --config tests/vitest.config.mts tests/integration"
scripts.test:e2e: npm --prefix functions run build && node scripts/with-java.mjs firebase emulators:exec --project demo-xiangqi --only database,firestore,auth,functions,tasks "playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts"
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:rules && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
